hero.title: Industrial solutions, automotive service, and co-learning under one bold technical vision.
hero.description: STIC is positioned as more than a company. It is a productive and educational ecosystem that manufactures, maintains, automates, repairs, and develops real-world technical talent.

headline.title: Built to fabricate, maintain, automate, and repair with clarity.
headline.description: A quieter, more direct presentation of the STIC vision: useful work, reliable service, and practical learning.

signals.oneLabel: Industry, automotive service, and practical education in one system
signals.twoLabel: Built around real machinery, real maintenance, and real technical learning
signals.threeLabel: Designed to grow from service operation into a broader technical ecosystem

showcase.title: Three engines working together
showcase.description: A unified structure where each line strengthens the next.

pillars.title: One venture, three mutually reinforcing lines of value.
pillars.description: Each line is viable on its own, but the strategic strength comes from how they reinforce each other in capability, reputation, and impact.
pillars.industrialDescription: Custom machinery fabrication, maintenance, and automation focused on efficiency, reliability, and productivity.
pillars.automotiveDescription: General diagnostics and hands-on mechanical work that opens a practical service line with steady demand.
pillars.automotiveItemOne: Engine, suspension, brake, and transmission work
pillars.automotiveItemThree: Accessible entry point for new clients
pillars.learningDescription: A collaborative learning-by-doing environment where technical skills grow through real work and teamwork.
pillars.learningItemOne: Practical training in mechanics and automation

slides.oneDescription: Custom fabrication, maintenance, and automation are positioned as the technical backbone of the brand.
slides.twoTitle: Automotive service with practical market access
slides.twoDescription: Mechanical diagnostics and repair create a hands-on service line with recurring opportunities and daily relevance.
slides.threeDescription: Knowledge transfer happens through real projects, shared responsibility, and visible technical growth.

difference.title: The difference is the combination.
difference.description: STIC brings together business strength, real social contribution, and technical rigor, creating a brand that can serve clients and develop people at the same time.
difference.technicalDescription: STIC is built to solve real operational problems, not just present ideas.
difference.executionDescription: Industrial rigor and practical mechanical service create trust through results.
difference.impactDescription: The business model also becomes a place where people gain skills, confidence, and experience.

vision.title: A practical model that can generate revenue and grow talent.
vision.description: The industrial and automotive lines create service and cash flow opportunities, while the co-learning project strengthens future capability, culture, and long-term resilience.
vision.featureTitle: From service company to technical ecosystem.
vision.featureDescription: STIC can attract clients through industrial or automotive work, deepen trust through technical execution, and multiply impact through collaborative learning.

vision.capabilityDescription: Real projects become practical laboratories for technical growth.
